verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser is a cloud browser platform with SDKs, a CLI (`hx`), and the open-source HyperAgent, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The only 'tracking' mention is credit-based billing metering, which is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
